1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts a prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
2. Coverage: the entry's before and after sides span the paths the recording can touch — the union of the target's owned set before and after the recording, including a path its own placement first makes owned — so a path absent before is carried with a null before side and a present after side. Fail on a placeable path the entry does not carry — name the path.
content.rationale: The recording snapshot is where the journal store meets the bracket, its observation rule and the ownership rule. Ownership is ref-derived (xzxtxymq): the node document is an owned path, so a recorded document that lists a new ref path makes that path owned by the same recording. qokrosvu gives the entry a null before side for a path absent before, which is how such a path is carried, and the bracket and observation rule (pmxnnvvq, urqytyqn) put both readings inside the operation, so the union is decidable. A licence-only reading checks contradiction; the refined use is coverage — whether a path the recording itself makes owned is in the journal's set — which no single prerequisite states as a prohibition. The coverage clause is what makes the entry answer to the ownership it places.
